title: The Mechanism of Xuanyu Tongjing Decoction Regulating NOD/NFkappaB Pathway to Inhibit Ectopic Tissue Inflammation to Reduce Ovarian Damage in Rats with Ovarian Endometriosis.
authors: Fan, Weisen; Zhai, Fengting; Yuan, Zheng; Hu, Guotao; Wang, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药方剂通过NOD/NFkappaB通路抑制子宫内膜异位症炎症，虽涉及分子对接但核心是疾病机制与中药疗效，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: In traditional Chinese medicine texts, Xuanyu Tongjing Decoction (XYTJD) is a prescribed remedy for premenstrual belly pain and dysmenorrhea. It is currently routinely used to treat ovarian endometriosis (OEM) with good outcomes. AIM: In order to investigate the underlying processes of Xuanyu Tongjing Decoction in treating OEM inflammation and reducing ovarian damage. METHODS: We created a rat model of OEM and carried out transcriptome sequencing. Batch molecular docking technique in conjunction with Ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography-quadrupole-time-of-flight-high-resolution mass spectrometry was used to screen the main active components in Xuanyu Tongjing Decoction. RESULTS: The ectopic cyst was firmly attached to the ovary in our successfully created rat model of ovarian endometriosis. According to GSEA enrichment study, XYTJD may up-regulate pathways linked to oocyte formation in ovarian tissues and down-regulate immunological and inflammatory pathways in ectopic tissues. Rat ectopic tissues and human ectopic tissues showed a similar pattern in the expression of the NOD/NFkappaB pathway during the proliferative phase. In ectopic tissues of rats, XYTJD may down-regulate the NOD/NFkappaB pathway and suppress the expression of TNF-alpha and IL-1beta, which are downstream inflammatory factors in this pathway. In addition, XYTJD may restore the down-regulation of cAMP/PI3K/AKT and lower the expression of apoptotic factor CASP9, endoplasmic reticulum stress protein SEC61B and antioxidant protein GSTM5 in the ovary with ectopic tissue attachment. Following identification, the three samples' intersection included 10 active compounds in total. There was a 21-component overlap in active ingredients between rat and human serum. After a preliminary virtual screening, beta-Hederin, Proanthocyanidin A2, and Cimiside E were suggested to be the essential components that interfere with NOD/NFkappaB. CONCLUSION: In rats with proliferative OEM, XYTJD may down-regulate the NOD/NFkappaB pathway in ectopic tissues, consequently alleviating ovarian tissue damage by reducing inflammation brought on by ectopic tissues.
abstract_zh: 引言：在传统中医文献中，玄玉通经汤（XYTJD）是治疗经前腹痛和痛经的处方药。目前，它常规用于治疗卵巢子宫内膜异位症（OEM），并取得了良好疗效。目的：探讨玄玉通经汤治疗OEM炎症及减轻卵巢损伤的潜在机制。方法：我们建立了大鼠OEM模型，并进行了转录组测序。采用批量分子对接技术结合超高效液相色谱-四极杆-飞行时间-高分辨质谱法，筛选玄玉通经汤中的主要活性成分。结果：在我们成功建立的大鼠卵巢子宫内膜异位症模型中，异位囊肿牢固附着于卵巢。根据GSEA富集分析，XYTJD可能上调卵巢组织中与卵母细胞形成相关的通路，并下调异位组织中的免疫和炎症通路。大鼠异位组织和人异位组织在增殖期NOD/NFkappaB通路的表达模式相似。在大鼠异位组织中，XYTJD可能下调NOD/NFkappaB通路，并抑制该通路下游炎症因子TNF-alpha和IL-1beta的表达。此外，XYTJD可能恢复cAMP/PI3K/AKT的下调，并降低附着异位组织的卵巢中凋亡因子CASP9、内质网应激蛋白SEC61B和抗氧化蛋白GSTM5的表达。经鉴定，三个样本的交集中共包含10种活性化合物。大鼠和人血清中的活性成分有21个组分重叠。经过初步虚拟筛选，beta-Hederin、Proanthocyanidin A2和Cimiside E被认为是干扰NOD/NFkappaB的关键成分。结论：在增殖期OEM大鼠中，XYTJD可能下调异位组织中的NOD/NFkappaB通路，从而通过减少异位组织引起的炎症来减轻卵巢组织损伤。
